name: ODDSTABLE
summary: 单机离线赛马 roguelite，2026 年 10 月 28 日上架，Kai Kai 开发并发行，分类为休闲／模拟／体育／策略：读六马场次、锁固定赔率、在十二场巡回里存活。商店 AI 披露说明生成式 AI 用于制作或协助本作预先生成的视觉素材（马匹插画、场景背景、契约与道具图标、装饰性 UI 美术、游戏 logo，以及 Steam 商店与库图），AI 协助工具还起草或修改了部分游戏内文本与本地化；全部素材在发售前生成，经开发者审阅、挑选与修改后作为固定资产随游戏发布，游戏过程中不生成 AI 内容，也不连接任何外部 AI 服务。本站据此把美术、撰写、翻译与宣传素材登记为已使用，把游戏运行登记为明确声明未使用，代码、音乐与配音三个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明。第三方转录页面的程度评级属该站判断，本站不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI tools were used during development to create or assist with portions of the game's pre-generated visual artwork, including horse illustrations, environmental backgrounds, contract and item icons, decorative UI artwork, the game logo, and Steam store and library artwork. AI-assisted tools were also used to draft or refine portions of in-game text and localization. All such materials were generated before release, then reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer, and are included in the game as fixed assets. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to any external AI service.

english.summary: An offline single player horse racing roguelite released on Oct 28, 2026, developed and published by Kai Kai and filed under Casual, Simulation, Sports and Strategy, where you read a six horse field, lock fixed odds and survive a twelve race tour. The Steam AI disclosure states that generative AI tools created or assisted the pre generated visual artwork, covering horse illustrations, environmental backgrounds, contract and item icons, decorative UI artwork, the game logo and the Steam store and library artwork, and that AI assisted tools also drafted or refined portions of the in game text and localisation, with everything generated before release, reviewed, selected and edited by the developer and shipped as fixed assets, no AI content generated during gameplay and no connection to any external AI service. This site records art, writing, translation and marketing as used, the live generation area as explicitly ruled out, and code, music and voice as not addressed because the disclosure never names them. The extent rating on the two aggregator entry pages is those sites own judgement and is not adopted, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, the identity (Kai Kai as both developer and publisher, a full release dated Oct 28, 2026) and the English discussion board, whose homepage lists 0 visible topics out of 0, meaning the board is currently empty. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, all 6 results were dispositioned and two sources were registered and read in full, the gameaicheck.com and gamedb.ai entry pages for this game, whose transcriptions match the store text while their AI extent ratings are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. Three of the remaining results were the same store page in other languages or through curator entry points already covered by the official evidence and one was this site own browse index. No independent press report or community dispute was found, which proves nothing beyond the reviewed disclosure.
